inventoryConclusion.note: Both databases identify the same single completed steward cottage. 'Every steward cottage' therefore means this one current object; future cottages must reuse the standard below.

standard.stories: two occupied stories plus roof/attic expression
standard.setbackRule: Keep the established cottage line, the five-column east lane and a landscape transition to the western slope.
requiredProgram: steward public office and records room
private bath and shared wash room

adultSuiteStandard.name: private red room
adultSuiteStandard.contentBoundary: tasteful, adult-only and non-graphic; no explicit imagery or descriptive sexual detail
adultSuiteStandard.palette: deep red, oxblood, dark wood, blackened metal and warm low lighting
safety: decorative suspended frame remains non-load-bearing until independently engineered
privacy lock opens from inside without key, tool or special knowledge
suite is never part of a required exit route
clear circulation around bed/lounge and wash fixtures
cleanable finishes and dedicated closed storage
no sightline from public, staff or child/family rooms

cottages.name: Steward House mini-mansion

surfaceSurvey.interpretation: High values are primarily the existing cottage roof. Grade new occupied floors at y67/68 and use stepped stone plinths toward the west.

massing.program: new principal two-story hall and bedroom wing
retain/refit cottage as steward office, records room and family service wing
glazed/timber garden gallery around preserved water court
covered south patio, outdoor dining, hearth, benches and planted edge
preserve the surveyed wet column as a tiny lined rain/water garden; no structural target at -115,*, -336
screened bins, wood store and maintenance access

rooms.program: entry hall, bench, cloak and stair
great room with hearth and west outlook
formal dining opening to patio axis
retained steward office and public records counter
primary bedroom, dressing and private bath
manager library, budget desk and quiet reading
lockable privacy vestibule; inside release always possible and no required egress crosses it

eastLane.rule: Keep entirely clear between Steward House and Moot Hall.

circulation.stairs: one main stair in the entry hall plus one remote enclosed stair at the west end

garageDecision.reason: The current Ravensreach cottage lane is a pedestrian/historic town route, not a proven vehicle street. An automotive garage would break the palette and consume the five-column neighbor lane.
garageDecision.substitute: screened service yard, wood store and covered maintenance bay; a future garage requires a separately proven vehicle route

neighborSpacing.rule: Patio may meet but not cross the recorded boundary.

cottages.blockEntityRule: Preserve all nine existing block entities/NBT contents until a reviewed move ledger assigns their final rooms.

futureCottageRule: Any later database object named or role-assigned as a steward cottage receives a new per-site survey and the same program/privacy/safety standard; do not clone RRCH-STEWARD coordinates.
releaseGates: fresh immutable snapshot and database inventory proving the complete steward-cottage count
exact terrain, wet-column, vegetation, block-entity and entity census
five-column east lane and thirteen-column north setback remain clear
normal-walk route from town street to office, household, patio and both exits
red-room privacy vestibule is not an exit path and opens from inside without special knowledge
suspended decorative frame independently reviewed or built as visibly non-load-bearing scenery
acoustic/privacy and wash/cleanup separation from kitchen, public office and family bedrooms
exact-state forward/rollback package and matched before/after media
